mean_win: Arithmetic mean of positive original round_pnl in CNY
mean_loss: Arithmetic mean of negative original round_pnl in CNY; negative sign retained
payoff: mean_win / abs(mean_loss), undefined without wins or losses
mean_net: Arithmetic mean original round_pnl over all closed rounds
tail: Original round_return_on_cumulative_cost >= 0.30; original cumulative buy gross plus fees denominator, includes all original layers; no new R denominator
empty_groups: n=0 explicit; undefined means and sums remain null. For nonempty closed groups with no tail, tail_n=0 and tail_net=0.
quality: Signal-source UNKNOWN, observed holding-facts gaps and financial certification are different axes. No CP today is an observed category, not UNKNOWN.
financial_contract: Old proxy cash plus accrued dividends; every row remains NOT_NET80_CERTIFIED. No new financial validation.
original_artifacts: Keep every prior artifact byte unchanged. New supplementary report is a footnote, not a replacement.
